content: Research in neural network model compression has been concomitant with the rise in popularity of neural networks themselves, since these models have often been memory-intensive for the hardware of their time. Work in model compression for NLP applications falls broadly into four categories: matrix approximation, parameter pruning/sharing, weight quantization and knowledge distillation.
